Nina: Quick sync 1 I'm consolidating a compact 429/timeouts troubleshooting bundle: single canonical curl repro, tiny Python/JS retry snippets, and a short migration note for Retry-Mode header. Draft PR opened on staging. Can folks glance?
Sam: Ok. Use exponential backoff + full jitter in examples. Add a stress repro command and call out X-RateLimit-* headers to watch.
Liu: Also include a short note about context clipping: service will set X-Context-Truncated when older turns are evicted; recommend trimming prior turns or enabling prefix caching.
Nina: Added curl example and SDK snippets; included mapping table to curl for repros. I'll run link-check and backport to the 429 playbook.
Deploy-bot: PR #6312 merged to docs-staging at 7098801238 :rocket:
